title: Agent Image Lab Trial 001 受控精华瓶样本经验
content: Agent Image Lab Trial 001 已完成一次 runtime-to-review v2 受控真实生图闭环：一张图、一次调用、零重试，经过 secretless activation、broker dispatch、Artifact Store 回写、人工接受、accepted_samples 登记、durable archive 和 memory-candidate no-write mapping。可复用经验是：产品细节型精华瓶提示词要把单瓶、完整瓶身、可检查滴管结构、空白标签、无可读文字、中性棚拍背景和产品边缘可读性写进同一份约束；这能测试模型是否真正服从结构和无文字要求。该样本适合作为受控执行链路和产品结构约束的参考，但不是最终品牌交付图，因为正式商业交付仍需要品牌标签或品牌视觉设计。证据引用：accepted_samples/accepted_premium_skincare_serum_bottle_r2r_v2_trial_001_001/metadata.json；reports/runtime_to_review_v2/r2r_v2_trial_001_serum_detail_control_receipt.json；reports/runtime_to_review_v2/r2r_v2_trial_001_serum_detail_control_durable_archive_execution_report_20260608.json；reports/runtime_to_review_v2/r2r_v2_trial_001_serum_detail_control_memory_candidate_no_write_mapping_gate_20260608.json。
